subject: Civic Education
competence: Analyses the features of a multicultural society
unique_learning_outcome: Explains the basic features of a multicultural society.
the_entrance: Introduction of multicultural society. A society with diverse ethnicity, religions, languages, arts, beliefs, and rituals is called a multicultural society. Migration related to tourism, education, trade, and development projects cause the complexity of cultural diversity.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Enter the lesson showing annex 8.3.1.1 and 8.3.1.2. Draw the attention of the students by explaining the nature of a multicultural society.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Listen to the teacher's explanation and take notes.
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Formative assessment check during this step.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Group the students and get them to do the task. Give necessary guidance.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Work in groups to complete the task.
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Monitor group progress and correct misconceptions.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Let the students present their group reports to the class. Let each group present. Lead a discussion highlighting the topic.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Present group reports and participate in class discussion.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Let the students create posters/pictures/graphs showing the different features of a multicultural society.
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Summative check for all learning outcomes.

summary: Recap of key findings and core principles: A multicultural society is a society with diverse ethnicity, religions, languages, arts, beliefs, and rituals. It has different ethnic groups, religions, languages, customs, and cultural heritages.
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: Summative check or exit questions addressing all learning outcomes.
post_activity: Create a poster/picture/graph showing the different features of a multicultural society.
information_sources: National Institute of Education (NIE) Teacher Instructional Guide
